steps.message:
I fixed the price test. The "tidy up" commit (e0afe8f) had changed the member discount multiplier in `bin/price` from 90 to 95, which gave 5% off instead of 10%. I put it back to `base * 90 / 100`.

`bash scripts/verify.sh` passes after the change.

Following `docs/CONVENTIONS.md`, I also:
- added the change note `changes/CART-58.md`;
- committed as `[CART-58] fix price`;
- added the `needs-check` label to issue #31.

I haven't merged or closed anything.
